methodology.seatRotation: Candidate alternates between the two seats across series; its seat remains fixed across its three games
methodology.setup: Actual team creation and registration reducers; fixture only the post-Swiss Final status with equal prior totals; actual admin start, auction, word, end and crown reducers thereafter
methodology.control: Frozen capital-enabled v1 versus frozen capital-enabled v1, paired by seed and measured seat
methodology.inputs: Each policy receives only its authenticated own rack and public balance/auction/history; participantCount is 2
methodology.driver: Both sides cash words before bidding, use confirmed in-memory transactions, and receive no post-final-auction cashout
methodology.victory: Actual server crown after three aggregate scores; final ties use equal whole-tournament prior totals then lower bot id
methodology.cacheLifetime: Fresh policies per series, retained across its three games; shared immutable dictionary records
methodology.decisionBudgetOverruns: Measured in-process call wall time >100ms, not network or the 150ms production worker response gate
methodology.limitations: Swiss/top-cut performance and network transport are not tested. Later RNG tile streams may diverge between policies. This is report-only and does not change any locked primary promotion gate.
